document.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
document.disclaimer: This document is a draft template provided for convenience and is not legal advice. Cofoundaz is not a law firm. Have a qualified lawyer review it before you sign or rely on it.

sections.body: This Non-Disclosure Agreement is made on 2026-10-25 between NovaPay (the "Disclosing Party") and Bright Ventures Ltd (the "Receiving Party").
sections.heading: Parties

sections.body: The Disclosing Party will share confidential information with the Receiving Party solely for the following purpose: Evaluating a seed investment. The Receiving Party may not use the information for any other purpose.
sections.heading: Purpose

sections.body: "Confidential Information" means any non-public information the Disclosing Party shares in any form, including business plans, financials, customer and supplier details, product designs, source code and know-how, whether or not it is marked confidential.
sections.heading: Confidential Information

sections.body: The Receiving Party will: keep the Confidential Information secret using at least the care it uses for its own confidential material; share it only with people who need to know it for the purpose above and who are bound by equivalent duties; and not copy it except as the purpose requires.
sections.heading: Obligations of the Receiving Party

sections.body: These duties do not apply to information that: is or becomes public through no fault of the Receiving Party; was already known to the Receiving Party without a duty of confidence; is received lawfully from a third party; or must be disclosed by law, in which case the Receiving Party will give the Disclosing Party prompt notice where allowed.
sections.heading: Exclusions

sections.body: This agreement covers information shared from the effective date. The duties of confidentiality continue for 2 years after the effective date.
sections.heading: Term

sections.body: On request, the Receiving Party will promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information and confirm in writing that it has done so.
sections.heading: Return or Destruction

sections.body: The Receiving Party acknowledges that a breach may cause harm that money alone cannot repair, and that the Disclosing Party may seek an injunction in addition to any other remedy.
sections.heading: Remedies

sections.body: This agreement is governed by the laws of Lagos State, Nigeria, and its courts have jurisdiction over any dispute.
